## How to Change the Content of Demos?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-change-the-content-of-demos/>

If you have already imported the Spacious demos and want to modify and customize its contents for your site then you can easily do it with **Customizer**.

From your WordPress Dashboard navigate to **Appearance **> **Customize**. You will be taken directly to the Customizer interface, with your site preview on the right, and the Customizer menu on the left. From here, you can choose the options you like.

Spacious Theme provides you with various options to customize your site and make it look impressive. It includes the options to customize each section of your sites i.e. header, footer, layouts, and many more. If you want to change the demo content and design for your page or post, please follow the theme documentation for each of them as needed.

If you want to change the Post content, then

- Go to **Posts > All Posts.**
- Hover over the post and click on **Edit. **After that, you can change the **title**, **content **of the post as well as **Featured Image** for the post.
- To select an individual layout for the post, you can select from Select Layout available in the bottom right of Page Editor. It is shown in the image below:

**Similarly, you can edit the pages and its content.**

## How to Get Starter Sites With Spacious Demos?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-get-starter-sites-with-spacious-demos/>

If you are using the Spacious theme and want to import the demo for your site then you are at the right place. You can import the demo in two different ways, i.e. in one click or Manually.

1. **Install Demo in One Click:**

Follow the steps below to import the demo in one click.

- Install and Activate the Spacious Theme
- After the theme is installed and activated, a notice will appear on the dashboard prompting you to get started with the theme.
- Click on Get Started With Spacious. It will automatically set up the ThemeGrill Demo Importer plugin and redirect you to the demos page. You can check out the demo and import the one you like. To do that, you can just hover the mouse cursor over the demo and click on import.

**If you want to know more about importing demos. View in Detail**

2. **Import Demo Manually:**

If you missed the welcome notice, then you can import the demo manually. Just follow the steps below:

- Install and Activate the Spacious theme.
- From your WordPress Dashboard, go to **Plugins > **Add New and search for **ThemeGrill Demo Importer**

- Then install and activate ThemeGrill Demo Importer plugin.
- Now go to **Appearance **> **Demo Importer** and take a look at available demos.
- Click on import on the demo you like.
